About this item

  • CRI94 Full Spectrum Eye-Caring Light: Designed for comfortable all-day use, the Honeywell HWT-H2 LED desk lamp delivers soft, flicker-free full spectrum lighting with RG1 low blue light technology and CRI94 color accuracy to help reduce visual fatigue while reading, studying, working, or gaming.
  • 4 Color Modes & Stepless Dimming: Customize your lighting with 4 color temperatures ranging from warm 2700K to cool 5700K, plus smooth dimming control from 10%–100%. Easily create the ideal atmosphere for focused work, relaxing evenings, bedside reading, or home office setups.
  • Wide Lighting Coverage for Home Office Desks: The 11-inch rectangular lamp head provides bright, even illumination across desks, keyboards, monitors, and small workspaces while reducing harsh glare and shadows. Perfect for home offices, bedrooms, dorm rooms, study areas, and creative workstations.
  • USB-A & USB-C Charging Ports: Conveniently charge phones, tablets, earbuds, and other devices directly from the lamp base with built-in USB-A and USB-C charging ports. The lamp operates through a stable plug-in power connection for reliable daily use.
  • Foldable Touch Control Design with Timer & Memory: Featuring a modern foldable structure with adjustable multi-angle positioning, this dimmable desk lamp saves space while delivering flexible lighting exactly where you need it. Includes sensitive touch controls, a 30-minute auto-off timer, and memory function that restores your last lighting setting.

      My old Led desk lamp died. begrudgingly I began researching for a yellow (natural) light replacement. I've stayed away from the weird blue light walmart el cheapos because I've thrown a couple of those in the trash just because of that color. This lamp is the answer. It's so much nicer than my previous purchases. The light is soft and as bright as you want it. Dims down to night light level if so desired. The spectrum for eye care is spot on, perfectly natural. I'll never use the turn off timer but that usb c charging cord outlet will be used the rest of it's life on my coffee table. Love this new feature more than anything else. So Practical. Awesome lamp, sturdy. Way better than those usb powered lamps.

      A Superb Desk Lamp for my Needs
      Reviewed in the United States on August 8, 2024
      Color: White

      I don't usually write reviews, but I had to write one for this Honeywell desk lamp. I wanted to acknowledge that for a highly reasonable price, about $30, I got an incredibly functional, lightweight lamp that is just what I wanted. What sets it apart from other similar lamps is that the light bar swivels so that I can shine light truly where I want to. I like the fact that the dimming is done using a plus-minus bar on the lamp base. The options for different colors are obtained intuitively, and the result is very pleasing. In addition, when I don't want the light at all, it folds up and goes behind my computer screen, out-of-the-way. Brilliant. I have had other desk lamps which are a nuisance because I bump into them inadvertently. But with this one, I can take it out only when I want to. Furthermore, I can have exceptionally bright light or at night very dim light. So, I would highly recommend this lamp.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Good lighting, not good for current usb chargers
      Reviewed in the United States on October 17, 2025
      Color: Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Was looking for a foldable lamp, small enough to blend into the background, but powerful enough to give good lighting. This fits the bill perfectly for my needs. And at less than 30 bucks from a known brand, I couldn't be happier.

      I wasn't looking for a touch lamp, but the touch controls work as expected. Very responsive. Light dimming slider works better than expected.

      Folding joints seem strong. I'll try and update after a while, as the folding feature was the main reason I went with this light.

      The pictures don't do the actual lighting justice. It gets extremely bright. On any setting. Works well in full daylight.

      Only 3 big cons for me:

      First and foremost, the usb charging ports. They only support the 5W/2A. No fast charging, let alone the current super fast charging.

      For energy efficiency, this light isn't the best. Not the worst I've seen, but not great.

      It will get hot. The brighter and lighter the settings, the hotter it gets.

    About this Item

    • CRI94 Full Spectrum Eye-Caring Light: Designed for comfortable all-day use, the Honeywell HWT-H2 LED desk lamp delivers soft, flicker-free full spectrum lighting with RG1 low blue light technology and CRI94 color accuracy to help reduce visual fatigue while reading, studying, working, or gaming.
    • 4 Color Modes & Stepless Dimming: Customize your lighting with 4 color temperatures ranging from warm 2700K to cool 5700K, plus smooth dimming control from 10%–100%. Easily create the ideal atmosphere for focused work, relaxing evenings, bedside reading, or home office setups.
    • Wide Lighting Coverage for Home Office Desks: The 11-inch rectangular lamp head provides bright, even illumination across desks, keyboards, monitors, and small workspaces while reducing harsh glare and shadows. Perfect for home offices, bedrooms, dorm rooms, study areas, and creative workstations.
    • USB-A & USB-C Charging Ports: Conveniently charge phones, tablets, earbuds, and other devices directly from the lamp base with built-in USB-A and USB-C charging ports. The lamp operates through a stable plug-in power connection for reliable daily use.
    • Foldable Touch Control Design with Timer & Memory: Featuring a modern foldable structure with adjustable multi-angle positioning, this dimmable desk lamp saves space while delivering flexible lighting exactly where you need it. Includes sensitive touch controls, a 30-minute auto-off timer, and memory function that restores your last lighting setting.

    Product Description

    HONEYWELL LED Desk Lamp - HWT-H2 Sunturalux™ Eye-Caring Foldable Desk Light with USB A+C Dual Charging Port 4 Color Modes Dimmable Table Lamp for Home Office Bedroom Reading Study Work - Black
